ladder.label: UNCONFIRMED TURN
ladder.why: A daily bottoming setup is forming (swing low in, momentum turned up) — but the higher timeframes haven't confirmed it: the bigger picture is still bearish (weekly momentum negative; investor cycle overdue). This is an UNCONFIRMED TURN, not a confirmed buy. Weekly confirmation lags price, so this exact reading covers BOTH bounces that fail AND the first leg of a genuine new cycle — you can't tell which in real time, so treat it as a risk/size signal, not a direction call. Measured: weekly-unconfirmed bottoming setups held the low ~49% of the time vs ~68% once the weekly turns up.
ladder.next: Nimble traders only — small size, defined stop below 562.5. Not an investment buy yet. What would upgrade it: weekly momentum turning up, a reclaim of the investor-cycle low, or the first daily cycle right-translating — add on confirmation, not ahead of it.

ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BEARISH — weekly momentum negative; investor cycle overdue (investor cycle week 30 · daily cycle day 40).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): unconfirmed turn. Bigger picture (counter-trend): bearish.
points: Bigger picture is bearish (counter-trend for a daily long)

entry.text: An unconfirmed turn: a daily low is forming while the bigger picture is still bearish. Nimble traders only — small size, defined stop below 562.5. Not an investment buy until the weekly confirms; most of these fail, a minority start a new cycle.
entry.text_zh: 未确认转向：日线低点正在形成，但大局仍偏空。仅限灵活交易者——小仓位、止损设于 562.5 下方。在周线确认前并非投资性买入；多数最终失败，少数则开启新周期。

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 40 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_phase: inside the window where a low is due
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 40 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.daily_phase_zh: 处于低点应当出现的时间窗口内
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 30 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: overdue — the bigger cycle is stretched, expect more volatility
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 30 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 逾期——更大的周期已被拉伸，预计波动加剧
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its SECOND half ('right-translated') — strong cycles top late, a healthy-uptrend sign.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在后半段见顶（“右移”）——强周期见顶偏晚，属于健康上涨趋势的信号。

ladder.early_note: ⚡ Early reversal building (heads-up): StochRSI popped out of oversold. These anticipate a low BEFORE full confirmation — earlier entry, but a higher false-alarm rate, so treat as a heads-up to watch closely, not a trigger yet.
ladder.why_zh: 正在形成日线筑底形态（摆动低点已现、动量转向上行）——但更高周期尚未确认：大局仍偏空（周线动量为负；投资者周期已逾期）。这是「未确认转向」，并非已确认的买入。周线确认滞后于价格，因此同样的读数既涵盖最终失败的反弹，也涵盖真正新周期的第一段——实时无法判定属于哪一种，故应将其视为风险/仓位信号，而非方向判断。实测：周线未确认的筑底形态约 49% 守住低点，周线转向后升至约 68%。
ladder.next_zh: 仅限灵活交易者——小仓位、止损设于 562.5 下方。暂非投资性买入。何种情形会升级：周线动量转为向上、收复投资者周期低点、或首个日线周期呈右移结构——在确认之后加仓，而非提前。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看空 — 周线动量为负；投资者周期已逾期（投资者周期第 30 周 · 日线周期第 40 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：未确认转向。大局（逆势）：看空。

ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：偏弱未确认转向（+30）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
ladder.bc_line_zh: 日线 ✓ · 3日 ✓ · 周线 ✗ · 月线 ✗
ladder.bc_tip: Confidence this is a DURABLE, low-drawdown bottom: how near price is to the cycle low (the drawdown-depth axis) discounted when higher timeframes haven't confirmed the turn. Measured: weekly confirmation lifted the 'cycle-low held' rate ~19pp — a higher score held far more often. Risk/durability, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.bc_tip_zh: 衡量当前是否为「持久、低回撤」底部的信心：价格距周期低点的远近（回撤深度轴），并在更高周期尚未确认转向时打折。实测：周线确认使「周期低点守住」的比例提升约 19 个百分点——分数越高，低点守住的概率越大。这是风险/持久性，并非收益预测。
